objective: M2 static ISA/ABI gate before simulating
action: inspected readelf -S section layout and objdump disassembly of first build
result: Found 2 real bugs via static analysis alone (caught before spending simulation cycles): (1) linker script only matched .data/.bss, but RV32 GCC places small globals in .sdata/.sbss by default -- g_zero landed outside the __bss_start/__bss_end clear range entirely; (2) g_initialized was constant-folded away by -O1 since it's never mutated, silently defeating the .data-load test. Fixed: added .sdata/.sbss/.srodata to the linker script sections, made both globals volatile.
